name: stack-dock
description: The repository's devrouter stack in one press: the band above the prompt says whether it is unset, stopped or up, starts it with devrouter up, shows each service's URL and health in the status line and a /stack pane, and puts doctor's findings and the failing logs into the prompt for Claude to fix when asked

auto.title: Start on its own
auto.description: session-start runs devrouter up when a session starts and the stack is ready but stopped; off waits for a press

stopOnExit.title: Stop on exit
stopOnExit.description: Run devrouter down when the session ends; off by default, as devrouter stacks outlive sessions

feed.title: Feed Claude
feed.description: Attach a service going down, or devrouter up failing, to the next prompt typed at an idle prompt; on by default

pollSec.title: Poll (seconds)
pollSec.description: How often a running stack's containers and URLs are checked, 5 to 60; 10 by default
